notes.subject: bolo
notes.rationale: אִתְּנוּ 'with us' rendered 'an bolo' ('at our hand'), the natural Bambara expression of accompaniment

notes.subject: minnu
notes.rationale: Hebrew compresses 'those with us' into one relative clause; Bambara needs the relative pronoun 'minnu'

notes.subject: to the servant
notes.rationale: 'Fear not' is Elisha's direct word to his frightened servant

translation: A ko: “I kana siran, bawo minnu bɛ ⟨את⟩ an bolo, olu gɛlɛn ka bɔ minnu bɛ ⟨את⟩ u bolo.”

tokens.marks: minnu bɛ an bolo — olu min bɛ an ye
u — a dancɛw (ja min bilala dɔgɔtɔrɔso lamini na)
